source: src/components/CourseTestForm.jsx IMNCI_TEST_QUESTIONS (IMNCI Pre/Post Test Entry, used by every IMNCI course type, including the online IMCI course and IMNCI in humanitarian setting)

questions.text: 1. Which of the following signs are "general danger sign" in a sick child aged 2 months up to five years?

options.text: Axillary temperature ≥37.5°c for more than 7 days

questions.text: 2. All of the following are the main causes of mortality in under-five children in the country except?
3. For which setting are the IMCI guidelines suitable for use?

options.text: Inpatient ward of a district hospital
Inpatient ward of a specialized hospital

questions.text: 4. All of the following are needed to count the respiratory rate correctly in a child with cough except?

options.text: the count should always be repeated
the count should be for a full minute

questions.text: 5. Which of the following statements best describes wheezing?

options.text: It is a harsh sound during inspiration
It is a soft musical sound that is heard during the expiration
It is a soft musical sound during inspiration
If heard leaning close to the child's mouth, it should be confirmed by auscultation
